description: Fork of exp475 (LION, 1.4962). Changes: TinyOrderedMultiHeadLut(CONNECTED_QUADRUPLES, NAP=6, STE) for all 4 modules, double tph (qkv=128, v=512, out=2048, res=256). max_orders=24 (4! reachable of 64). LUT params ~56M vs ~75M exp475 (24 rows x 2x tables). Corrected STE implementation: hard argmax forward + index_add_ weight grad + soft input grad. exp480 had same config but wrong soft-fwd. Tests whether connected quadruple structure (more tables, fewer rows) with STE matches exp475.
